title: Output Upgrade
text: Right-click the held plate to configure directions and filters before installing it. Settings remain on the plate after removal.

Freely enable any of the six directions: front, back, left, right, up and down. Pushes one item per second into selected adjacent containers, visiting enabled directions in order. Fluids obey the globe transfer limit.
Uses the same filters as intake upgrades. This item rate applies only to the upgrade, not to external funnels or pipes.
